checks: KNOWN_TO_SYSTEM_AS_OF returns only the latest version whose confirmable publication and real Archive recorded_at are both no later than the requested time
PUBLICLY_AVAILABLE_AS_OF can select a version published by t but recorded later, while keeping the separately known-to-system version ID
later-recorded public material is marked system_unknown_at_as_of=true and is not mixed into the known result
event time is never treated as publication time; unknown and incomplete publication times cannot enter an exact as-of
date-only publication requires its source timezone and is not treated as available during that date merely by inventing midnight
results return the exact selected and current versions, published/recorded metadata, later version IDs and explicit limitations
body bytes are read only when requested and current intended-use, storage and revocation checks pass
INDEX never returns original body; revoked or missing body keeps historical metadata without substituting navigation or summary text
current query returns the latest version but fixes current_use_authorized=false; history lookup is not W15 adoption authority
an optional W15 decision is reported current only if decided by the as-of time, remains current and covers the required scope
navigation index can be rebuilt from authoritative Archive versions without creating a second history source
Concept, Background, MethodUse and TransmissionLink all use the same stable version/history interface
KnowledgeReuse appends one record referencing the exact old source, current source, target Article and Evidence
reuse records original/current/changed conditions, conclusion, limits and does_not_prove; they cannot record reader mastery or authorize publication
